```yaml
name: Conformance

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  generate-gh-pages:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Generate TypeDoc documentation
        run: ./scripts/generate-gh-pages.sh ${{ github.ref }}

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "GitHub Actions"
          git config --global user.email "actions@github.com"
          git add .
          git commit -m "Update API documentation for $(git describe --tags)"
          git push origin gh-pages

  publish-gh-pages:
    needs: generate-gh-pages
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v4
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          publish_dir: docs
```
